commonGround.hookJob: Validate the title in the first two sentences, open 2–3 curiosity gaps, withhold the full payoff, then force Section 1 with a 10–30 word rehook.
commonGround.rehookJob: End sections by creating a new unanswered need: contradiction, withheld detail, new person, or incomplete explanation. Vary the formula.
commonGround.lineJob: One spoken idea per line, about 10–15 words, visual-beat friendly.
commonGround.ctaJob: Two short subscribe CTAs: one near the middle woven into story, one in the outro. Never interrupt the strongest reveal.
commonGround.payoffJob: Release the title promise as a ladder across hook → early proof → contradiction → climax → lingering question.
